description.zh: 开启加速链路，订阅加速功能公测中，基于调度策略与网络链路优化， 可提升镜像订阅速度
description.en: Specifies whether to enable an acceleration link for image subscription. The subscription acceleration feature is in public preview. The feature is optimized based on scheduling policies and network links to accelerate image subscription.
The name of the Container Registry namespace.
Specifies whether to overwrite the original image.

description.zh: 操作系统/架构，当源端仓库中为多架构镜像时，只将指定的操作系统/架构，订阅到企业版实例的目标仓库
description.en: The operating system and architecture. If the source repository contains multi-arch images, only the images with the specified operating system and architecture are subscribed to the destination repository of the Enterprise Edition instance.
The name of the Container Registry repository.
The name of the source namespace.

The source of the artifacts.

Valid values:

*   DOCKER_HUB: Docker Hub
*   GCR: GCR
*   QUAY: Quay.io

description.zh: 订阅源端仓库镜像版本, 支持正则表达式
description.en: The image tags in the subscription source repository. Regular expressions are supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr update-artifact-subscription-rule --instance-id cri-c0o11woew0k0000 --rule-id crasr-mdbpung4i1rm0000 --source-provider DOCKER_HUB --source-namespace-name library --source-repo-name nginx --namespace-name test-ns --repo-name test-repo --tag-regexp release-v.0 --tag-count 1 --override true --accelerate true --platform 0/0 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr UpdateArtifactSubscriptionRule --region cn-hangzhou --Platform.1 '0/0' --NamespaceName 'test-ns' --TagCount 1 --SourceRepoName nginx --InstanceId 'cri-c0o11woew0k0000' --TagRegexp 'release-v.0' --RuleId 'crasr-mdbpung4i1rm0000' --RepoName 'test-repo' --SourceProvider DOCKER_HUB --Accelerate true --SourceNamespaceName library --Override true
